policy.appearance: object appearance may be renderer-authored but source position/type/properties remain separately identifiable
policy.geometry: only explicit NVDB object geometry is reprojected EPSG:25833->25832 and clipped to the exact Nannestad tile
policy.pagination: Every provider-issued opaque cursor is exhausted with original tile filter preserved; each raw page is SHA-256-bound, duplicates/cycles/unsafe links reject admission
policy.relations: NVDB V4 relation payload is preserved as source evidence but receives no inferred sign/support semantics in this compiler
policy.source_location: NVDB V4 location payload is preserved verbatim as source evidence for sequence/lane correlation; it does not replace explicit object geometry
policy.truth_guard: absence of an object is not proof of physical absence; no procedural object is represented as NVDB source truth
policy.vertical: point/line Z is intentionally not promoted; renderer grounds presentation against accepted NWE DTM
